p8_b0.ocr: The following data table presents a comprehensive analysis of the impact of various compounds on the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transport mechanism, focusing specifically on the regression coefficients, standard errors, and P values associated with each variable. The analysis examines the effects of different dosages of MEPH, including 2.5 mg/kg, 5 mg/kg, and 20 mg/kg, as well as a control with nor-MEPH at 5 mg/kg.

p8_b1.ocr: A notable finding is the regression coefficient of -2.76 for the MEPH 5 mg/kg treatment, which suggests a significant negative influence on P-gp activity, although the P value of 0.061 indicates that this result approaches, but does not meet, conventional significance thresholds. Additionally, the standard error of 1.47 provides insight into the variability of this estimate.
